description: This file defines the Oauth2Handler class which manages OAuth2 token validation, including preparing requests to token introspection endpoints, handling responses, and extracting user info. It includes methods for handling both introspection-specific and generic token info endpoints, and performs token validation asynchronously.

classes.name: Oauth2Handler
classes.description: Handles OAuth2 token validation, including preparation of requests, response handling, and user info extraction.

methods.name: bool _is_introspection_endpoint( token_info_endpoint: str, oauth_client_id: Optional[str], oauth_client_secret: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Determines if the given token info endpoint is an OAuth2 introspection endpoint based on URL and available credentials.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,str],Dict[str,str]] _prepare_introspection_request( token: str, oauth_client_id: Optional[str], oauth_client_secret: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Prepares headers and data for an OAuth2 introspection request, including Basic Authentication if credentials are provided.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _prepare_token_info_request(token: str)
methods.description: Prepares headers for a generic token info endpoint request.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str],Optional[str]] _extract_user_info( response_data: Dict, user_id_field_name: str, user_role_field_name: str, user_team_id_field_name: str, )
methods.description: Extracts user ID, role, and team ID from OAuth2 response data based on specified field names.

methods.name: UserAPIKeyAuth check_oauth2_token(token: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously validates an OAuth2 token by making a request to the configured token info or introspection endpoint, and returns user information if valid.
